options.name: In a fair fight only
options.text: We fight to win, never to butcher the beaten.

options.name: As we see fit
options.text: Whoever stands against us takes their chances.

options.name: Protect them
options.text: Ordinary people are under our protection.

options.name: Leave them be
options.text: We do not prey on people who cannot fight back.

options.name: Equal shares
options.text: Everyone takes the same, the captain included.

options.name: By rank
options.text: Officers take more; everyone takes something.

options.name: The captain's choice
options.text: The captain decides who gets what.

options.name: Whenever we like
options.text: A crew that cannot drink together cannot sail together.

options.name: In port only
options.text: Nobody drinks with the sea under them.

options.name: Let them go
options.text: Anyone may leave; nobody is kept against their will.

options.name: Marooned
options.text: A deserter is left on the nearest rock.

options.name: Shamed
options.text: Nobody runs. Not even the captain.

commands.name: The captain's word
commands.text: The captain decides. Asking is a courtesy.

commands.name: An officers' council
commands.text: The officers are heard before anything is decided.

commands.name: A crew vote
commands.text: Everyone has a say, and the vote stands.

structures.name: Flat
structures.text: Nobody outranks anybody but the captain.

structures.name: Ranks
structures.text: A first mate, officers, and everyone else.

structures.name: Numbered divisions
structures.text: Divisions with commanders, as in the great pirate fleets.

pays.name: Wages
pays.text: So much a month, whatever the sea brings.

pays.name: Nothing but the dream
pays.text: Food, a berth, and the dream.

roles.name: Captain
roles.bad: nobody would follow {them} into a tavern

roles.name: First mate
roles.bad: could not keep order in a rowing boat

perks.name: Iron order
perks.text: Mutiny checks roll against the first mate at a third harder.

roles.name: Quartermaster
roles.good: can count a hold of stores by eye

perks.name: A fair ledger
perks.text: Shares are split without a grumble: loot never counts as unfair.

perks.name: Grand Line weather
perks.text: Reads the Grand Line's weather: storms cost a third less hull.

roles.name: Helmsman
roles.good: holds a wheel in a gale
roles.bad: has never steered anything bigger than a cart

roles.name: Lookout
roles.good: sees a sail before anyone else
roles.bad: would miss a Sea King in a bathtub

roles.name: Sniper
roles.good: can hit a gull at a hundred paces
roles.bad: has never fired a shot in anger

roles.name: Cook
roles.bad: has never cooked for a crew

perks.name: Hearty meals
perks.text: Meals that restore Vigor: the captain's month at sea starts rested.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.good: has set bones and stitched wounds
roles.bad: faints at the sight of blood

perks.name: Any sickness
perks.text: Can treat any sickness: illnesses aboard heal twice as fast.

roles.name: Shipwright
roles.good: has built a hull with {their} own hands

perks.name: Repairs under fire
perks.text: Repairs mid-battle: damage control works twice as well.

roles.name: Musician
roles.good: has a song for every sea
roles.bad: cannot carry a tune in a barrel

roles.name: Archaeologist
roles.good: reads old scripts as others read the news
roles.bad: has never opened a history book

perks.name: The old script
perks.text: Can read what is carved on the indestructible stones (Phase 11).

roles.name: Fighter
roles.good: has stood in a real fight and won

perks.name: Division commander
perks.text: Can lead a division in a crew battle.

roles.name: Deck hand
roles.good: can haul a line all night
roles.bad: gets in the way on deck

posts.name: Helm
posts.emptyText: Nobody at the helm: a voyage runs about 6% slower.

posts.name: Navigation
posts.emptyText: No navigator: the captain reads the charts, and no faster for it.

posts.name: Lookout
posts.emptyText: Nobody in the crow's nest: more trouble finds the ship.

posts.name: Rigging crew
posts.emptyText: Nobody on the rigging: the sails are trimmed badly, 8% slower.

posts.name: Galley
posts.emptyText: Nobody in the galley: scurvy comes sooner, morale sinks, stores spoil.

posts.name: Sick bay
posts.emptyText: Nobody in the sick bay: wounds heal only as fast as they will.

posts.name: Repairs
posts.emptyText: Nobody on repairs: the hull mends only in a yard.

posts.name: Officer of the watch
posts.emptyText: No officer of the watch: grumbling grows into worse.

posts.name: Gun crew, upper deck
posts.emptyText: Nobody on the upper guns: a third of the broadside is silent.

posts.name: Gun crew, lower deck
posts.emptyText: Nobody on the lower guns: a third of the broadside is silent.

posts.name: Powder runners
posts.emptyText: Nobody running powder: the guns fire slowly, a quarter less damage.

posts.name: Sharpshooters in the rigging
posts.emptyText: Nobody in the rigging with a rifle: the gunners aim alone.

posts.name: Boarding party
posts.emptyText: No boarding party: whoever goes over the rail goes leaderless.

posts.name: Guard against boarders
posts.emptyText: Nobody guarding the deck: boarders come aboard unopposed.

posts.name: Helm
posts.emptyText: Nobody at the helm in a fight: she turns slowly, escapes and rams fail.

posts.name: Damage control
posts.emptyText: No damage control: fires burn longer and hotter.

posts.name: Medic station
posts.emptyText: No medic station: big blows leave worse injuries.

posts.name: The captain's deck
posts.emptyText: Nobody on the captain's deck: the crew fights without a voice to follow.

posts.name: Shore party
posts.emptyText: No shore party: what is said in the taverns stays there.

posts.name: Ship's guard
posts.emptyText: Nobody guarding the ship: thieves help themselves to the stores.

posts.name: Purser
posts.emptyText: No purser: you pay what the stalls ask.

posts.name: Recruiter
posts.emptyText: No recruiter: only those who come asking are on the list.

posts.name: Lookout
posts.emptyText: No lookout in port: a raid comes with no warning.

posts.name: Helm
posts.emptyText: Nobody at the helm in a storm: she is blown off course, weeks lost.

posts.name: Lines and sails
posts.emptyText: Nobody on the lines: the sails tear and the masts take it.

posts.name: Pumps
posts.emptyText: Nobody on the pumps: the hull takes 40% more from storms.

posts.name: Lashing the cargo
posts.emptyText: Nobody lashing the cargo: stores go over the side.

traditions.name: The victory toast
traditions.line: The {crew} raise their cups the way they always do now after a win: one for the living, one for the sea.

traditions.name: The crew's song
traditions.line: Somewhere out of sight of land, the {crew} sing their song again, badly and loudly.

traditions.name: The sake cup
traditions.line: {name} drinks from the crew's cup, as everyone who joins the {crew} does now.

traditions.name: A promise to an absent friend
traditions.line: The {crew} keep a place at the table for {name}. They always will.

traditions.name: Founding day
traditions.line: Another year of the {crew}: a feast on the deck, and the old stories told again.

traditions.name: The vow after a defeat
traditions.line: After the beating, the {crew} make the same vow they always make: never again.

missions.name: Scout an island
missions.text: Go ahead, and come back with what is there.

report.criticalSuccess: {name} is back from {target} with a sketch of every road and who walks them: {report}
report.criticalFailure: {name} was spotted on {target} and barely got away: {report}

report.success: {name} came back with talk from the taverns: {report}
report.criticalFailure: {name} said too much and heard too little: {report}

missions.name: Buy supplies
missions.text: Fill the hold, and do not get cheated.

report.criticalFailure: {name} picked a fight instead of a recruit: {report}

missions.name: Collect a debt
missions.text: Someone owes you. Make them pay.

report.criticalSuccess: {name} came back with every Berry {target} owed, and an apology: {report}

missions.name: Carry a message
missions.text: Take word to someone, and bring theirs back.

report.criticalSuccess: {name} delivered your word to {target}, and came back with theirs and more: {report}
report.criticalFailure: {name} lost the message on the way: {report}

report.criticalSuccess: {name} held {target} and sent off two lots of trouble: {report}
report.failure: {name} kept watch over {target}, and was robbed anyway: {report}

missions.name: Track someone
missions.text: Find out where they are and what they are doing.

report.criticalSuccess: {name} tracked {target} down to the very house: {report}
report.criticalFailure: {target} noticed {name} following and laid a false trail: {report}

pitches.name: A dream
pitches.text: Tell them where you are going, and why.

pitches.name: Freedom
pitches.text: No master, no orders but your own.

pitches.name: Adventure
pitches.text: The whole sea, and everything on it.

pitches.name: Money
pitches.text: Pay, and a share of everything.

pitches.name: Revenge
pitches.text: Whoever wronged them, you will help them pay.

pitches.name: Protection
pitches.text: Nobody will hurt them while you stand.

pitches.name: Belonging
pitches.text: A place among people who will not leave them.

pitches.name: A cause
pitches.text: Something bigger than any of you.

objections.line: {name} shakes {their} head. “I have family here who need me.”

answers.label: Promise to bring them home safe and often
answers.line: {name} holds your eye a long moment. {say.agree}

answers.label: Leave money for the family
answers.line: {name} looks at the purse, then at you. {say.grateful}

objections.line: {name} laughs. “You? I could beat you with one arm.”

answers.label: Show them what you are made of
Let them see you fight first
Tell them the truth about your crew
Promise you will never hurt the innocent

objections.line: {name} looks around {their} workplace. “I have a trade here. A good one.”

answers.label: Tell them what the sea pays
Pay them for the work they leave

objections.line: {name} shakes {their} head. “I already have a captain.”

answers.label: Ask what their captain ever did for them

objections.line: {name} winces. “I owe money. They would come after me.”

answers.label: Promise to deal with anyone who comes

objections.line: {name} goes green at the very word. “The sea and I do not get on.”

answers.label: Laugh it off: everyone gets their sea legs

objections.line: {name} frowns. “I have no wish to fight for a living.”

answers.label: Promise they will never have to fight
Tell them who you fight for

objections.line: {name} chuckles. “Look at me. My sailing days are behind me.”

answers.label: Tell them you need what they know

kinds.name: A prodigy
kinds.text: a child whose teachers have stopped trying to teach

kinds.name: An anomaly
kinds.text: someone the island whispers about and nobody understands

kinds.name: A retired legend
kinds.text: an old sailor who once sailed with the greatest crews of the age

kinds.name: A hermit swordsman
kinds.text: a swordsman who lives alone and cuts waterfalls for practice

kinds.name: A wandering doctor
kinds.text: a doctor said to have cured a sickness every other doctor gave up on

secrets.name: A fugitive
secrets.text: {name} is running from a sentence {they} never served.

secrets.name: A lost royal
secrets.text: {name} was born royal, in a kingdom that no longer wants {them}.

secrets.name: A cursed bloodline
secrets.text: Everyone in {name}'s family has died young, and the reason is no secret to {them}.

secrets.name: A bounty under another name
secrets.text: {name} once had a bounty under another name, and a face on a poster.

signs: {name} was seen at the Den Den Mushi in the middle of the night.
{name} knew where you were going before you had said.
{name} slipped a letter to a stranger on the docks.
Someone has been through your charts, and {name} was on watch.

kinds.line: {name} sold your course to the Marines, and slipped away in the night.
{name} took the Devil Fruit from the hold and vanished with it.
{name} emptied the {crew}'s purse and was gone by morning.
{name} and a few hands cut the moorings and took the ship.

kinds.name: Ship graveyard
kinds.text: A tangle of old hulls to live in.

kinds.name: A territory's capital
kinds.text: The seat of an island you hold (Phase 9's territories).

rooms.name: Dock
rooms.text: Mends a moored ship's hull a month.

rooms.name: Armoury
rooms.text: Adds to the base's defence against raids.

rooms.name: Training ground
rooms.text: Crewmates train faster while ashore here.

rooms.name: Infirmary
rooms.text: Wounds heal faster here, crewmates' and yours.

rooms.name: Treasury
rooms.text: The common purse grows a little a month, and is safe from thieves.

rooms.name: Prison
rooms.text: Holds prisoners, and keeps them held.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.text: Crewmates' minds sharpen while ashore here.

rooms.name: Shrine
rooms.text: A quiet place: the crew's morale steadies.

orders.name: Patrol
orders.text: Sail the waters around a place and keep them yours.

orders.name: Escort
orders.text: Guard merchant ships for a fee.

orders.name: Hold a territory
orders.text: Stay, and let nobody else in.

orders.name: Join the next battle
orders.text: Sail with you and fight beside you.

lines.mutiny: The {crew} mutinied: {name} led them, and {count} went with {them}.
lines.grumble: The {crew} are grumbling: about the pay, the food, the captain.
lines.funeral: A funeral at sea for {name}: the {crew} stood bareheaded on the deck while {they} went into the water.
lines.retired: {name} has hung up {their} cutlass and left the {crew} to grow old somewhere quiet. {say.farewell}
lines.dreamLeave: {name} is leaving to chase {their} own dream: to {dream}. {say.farewell}
lines.promoted: {name} is an officer of the {crew} now. {say.proud}
lines.title: {name} has earned a name aboard: {post}.
lines.epithet: The papers have a name for {name} now: “{epithet}”.
lines.friction: {name} and {other} came to blows on deck.
lines.synergy: {name} and {other} fight like one person now.
lines.creedBroken: You broke the {crew}'s creed ({quest}), and they saw it.
lines.creedKept: You kept the {crew}'s creed ({quest}) when it would have been easier not to.
lines.spyCaught: {name} was a spy for {target}. You caught {them} at it.
lines.fleetSworn: {name} drank from your cup: {their} crew sails under your flag now.
lines.fleetBroke: {name} has broken away from your fleet.
lines.allianceMet: The alliance with {name} has done what it was for: {quest}.
lines.legendRumour: Somebody in {place} talks of {report}, out at {target}.
lines.childJoins: {name}, {other}'s child, wants to sail with the {crew}. {say.challenge}
